commit 346286229b2f3f51b970aefb1d129f6d18aaba2a
Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Dec 9 11:54:15 2025 -0500
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Dec 9 11:54:15 2025 -0500

    Bug 2004998 - Port bug 1975550: Update builders to rustc 1.90. rs=bustage-fix
    
    This change switches to the defaults of linux64-rust and win64-rust, which
    are currently rust 1.90.

diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
index a6ee9a34de4..ed06f0b9fb2 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/linux.yml
@@ -326,7 +326,7 @@ linux64-ccov/opt:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-libotr
             - linux64-grcov
-            - linux64-rust-1.83
+            - linux64-rust
             - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
 
 linux64-ccov/debug:
@@ -356,5 +356,5 @@ linux64-ccov/debug:
         toolchain:
             - linux64-libotr
             - linux64-grcov
-            - linux64-rust-1.83
+            - linux64-rust
             - sysroot-x86_64-linux-gnu
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
index f0d0aee2b46..0059eb23100 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/build/windows.yml
@@ -581,7 +581,7 @@ win64-ccov/opt:
             - win64-mozmake
             - win64-nasm
             - win64-node
-            - win64-rust-1.83
+            - win64-rust
             - win64-rust-size
             - win64-sccache
             - win64-winchecksec
diff --git a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
index 88299f925bd..ef716435521 100644
--- a/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/kinds/toolchain/kind.yml
@@ -39,7 +39,6 @@ reference-tasks:
     - linux64-pkgconf
     - linux64-python
     - linux64-rust
-    - linux64-rust-1.83
     - linux64-rust-cross
     - linux64-rust-dev
     - linux64-rust-macos
@@ -97,7 +96,6 @@ reference-tasks:
     - win64-node
     - win64-python
     - win64-rust
-    - win64-rust-1.83
     - win64-rust-size
     - win64-sccache
     - win64-winchecksec
